svg.title: Pragma circular blockchain architecture, orchestrator calls detection agents
svg.desc: Five agents sit on a ring around the central blockchain layer: detection agents D1 to D3, VFL agent, LLM agent, governance agent and execution agent. After verifying on the chain the execution agent calls the detection agents via API, gRPC or MCP, and at the same time notifies the event listener. Detection agents notify the event listener when done. The event listener reads the chain and feeds the log and audit system. The LLM agent gets policies from a RAG store. Numbers 1 to 12 show the order.
